## Change

What changed and why, with the evidence (a test, a results file, a measured number).

## Checklist

- [ ] Docstring updated for every changed public function
- [ ] Reference page updated if a key, field or format changed
- [ ] ADR added or superseded if this is a decision (pinned version, reward term, CUDA contract)
- [ ] `make test lint docs` pass
- [ ] No `src/` edit between a preflight and its teardown
